rows.label: Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly (GiveWell's benchmark)
rows.explainer: charityevals' number, not Ambitious Impact's: GiveWell's value of a dollar given to GiveDirectly, the same benchmark the site uses to convert GiveWell's multiples of cash. Used to put Ambitious Impact's DALY value of cash on the shared rate between a healthy year and a doubled-income year.

rows.label: $10,000 cash (by GD) DALY equivelent (Expected)
rows.explainer: Changed for consistency. Ambitious Impact values $10,000 given to GiveDirectly at 16.63 DALYs (CEA – Germany effectiveness!B38), from GiveWell staff's moral weights. Our view values it at GiveWell's benchmark, 0.00335 units of value per dollar, divided by the shared rate between a healthy year and a doubled-income year (Your values): 16.75 at the default of 2. The evaluator view uses Ambitious Impact's number.

Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for research, technical assistance and policy work: mostly people. Our judgment; we haven't seen this grant's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Researchers and advisers could typically earn considerably more in consulting or industry. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: DALYs averted per dollar
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2022 estimate for a new charity advocating for more cost-effective aid, modelled as Germany's development agency GIZ adopting cash benchmarking. The idea the Centre for Effective Aid Policy was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its expected-case cost per DALY equivalent.
